title: Same-Site Gas Volume and the Renewal Rate on Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
Where a business takes both electricity and gas from Beacon Ridge at one site, the gas volume billed at that site bears on the electricity renewal rate.

**Same-site gas adjustment.** On a Small Business Electricity Supply renewal accepted on or before the contract end date, the therms of the energy lines of the site's active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement posted in the 12 months before the handling date are added up; 5000 therms or more take 0.20 cents per kWh off the renewal rate; at least 1 but under 5000 therms take 0.10 cents off; no gas billed at the site in those months takes nothing off.

## Records read

- The Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the same site as the electricity agreement, in active status.
- That gas agreement's energy lines (therms billed) posted in the 12 months before the handling date; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

## Adjustment by therms

| Therms on the site's active gas agreement's energy lines in those 12 months | Same-site gas adjustment |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.20 cents per kWh off |
| 1 to 4999 | 0.10 cents per kWh off |
| none (including no active Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the site) | nothing off |

## Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical)

| Therms | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 0 | nothing off |
| 1 | 0.10 cents off |
| 4999 | 0.10 cents off |
| 5000 | 0.20 cents off |

A gas agreement held at another site of the business is not the site's gas agreement and adds no therms to this count.
